{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the count of -999 in biomarker_baseline
nan_count = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f'Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {nan_count}')

# Check for duplicate patient_id values
duplicate_count = df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()
print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {duplicate_count}')

# Check how many rows per patient_id
rows_per_patient = df.groupby('patient_id').size()
duplicates = rows_per_patient[rows_per_patient > 1]
print(f'Number of patients with multiple rows: {len(duplicates)}')

# Check sample_seq distribution per patient_id
sample_seq_max = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(f'Max sample_seq per patient ID: {sample_seq_max.max()}')"}
